proposal.expected_benefit: This change will prevent intent replay attacks by ensuring that intentIds are globally unique and cannot be reused, even with different PoI hashes.
proposal.problem: The system currently rejects duplicate PoI hashes but does not enforce on-chain rejection of reused intentIds with different PoI hashes, creating a potential vulnerability for intent replay attacks.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a policy that enforces the uniqueness of intentIds across all on-chain transactions, regardless of the PoI hash. This includes checking that an intentId has not been previously used in any transaction, even if the PoI hash differs.

risks.description: Introducing this policy may increase the computational overhead of intent validation, potentially affecting system performance.
risks.mitigation: Optimize the intentId lookup mechanism using a hash map or trie structure to ensure efficient validation.

risks.description: If the policy is incorrectly implemented, it may lead to false rejections of valid intents, causing operational disruptions.
risks.mitigation: Implement thorough unit and integration testing to ensure the policy behaves as intended.

proposal.rollback_plan: If the policy causes performance degradation or false rejections, revert to the previous behavior and investigate alternative optimizations for intentId validation.
security_invariants: INV-01: IntentIds must be globally unique across all on-chain transactions.
INV-02: Intent validation must reject any intent with a previously used intentId, regardless of PoI hash.
INV-03: The system must ensure that intentIds are not reused in any form of replay attack.
proposal.title: IntentId Reuse Prevention Policy

verification_tests.description: Test that an intent with a reused intentId (different PoI hash) is rejected on-chain.
verification_tests.expected_result: The intent is rejected with an error indicating intentId reuse.

verification_tests.description: Test that an intent with a new intentId (same PoI hash) is accepted.
verification_tests.expected_result: The intent is accepted and processed normally.
